tools.name: drives_search_vehicles
tools.description: Search the Pocket Drives marketplace for available rental vehicles by location, dates, category, and filters.

location.description: City or region name, e.g. "Miami, FL"

radius.description: Search radius in miles when using lat/lng

sort_by.description: Sort order, e.g. price_asc, price_desc, featured

query.description: Text search across make, model, and title

body_type.description: Body type filter, e.g. coupe, suv

category.description: Category filter, e.g. luxury, sports, electric

fuel_type.description: Fuel type filter, e.g. gasoline, electric

airport_iata_code.description: Filter by airport IATA code for delivery

airport_id.description: Filter by airport ID for delivery

venue_id.description: Filter by venue ID for delivery

organization_id.description: Filter to a specific host organization

tools.name: drives_vehicle_detail
tools.description: Get full details for a specific vehicle including rates, host info, and organization policies.

asset_id.description: Vehicle asset ID from search results

organization_id.description: Host organization ID from search results

tools.name: drives_vehicle_availability
tools.description: Get a monthly availability calendar with daily rates for a vehicle.

asset_rental_id.description: Rental asset ID from search or detail results

month.description: Month number (1-12); defaults to current month

year.description: Four-digit year; defaults to current year

tools.name: drives_get_quote
tools.description: Calculate a full rental quote including daily breakdown, taxes, deposit, and total for a date range.

asset_rental_id.description: Rental asset ID from search or detail results

tools.name: drives_location_suggest
tools.description: Autocomplete cities, airports, and venues for search location input.

tools.name: drives_airport_search
tools.description: Search airports for delivery pickup with delivery fee information.

query.description: Airport name or IATA code to search

tools.name: drives_venue_search
tools.description: Search stadiums, arenas, and venues for delivery pickup with delivery fee information.

query.description: Venue name or city to search

tools.name: drives_host_showroom
tools.description: Get a host profile page with bio, locations, team, and social links by username.

tools.name: drives_vehicle_reviews
tools.description: List published renter reviews for a vehicle. Uses asset_id (not asset_rental_id) per the GraphQL schema.

asset_id.description: Vehicle asset ID from search or detail results

limit.description: Maximum reviews to return (default server limit)

skip.description: Number of reviews to skip for pagination
